_comment: Price Truth raw-mark display holds (charter step 3, 'hold first'). A held card's raw mark stays in data/indices.json and in the index level (no restatement); every surface that prints it as a price, a move or a ratio prints 'being re-read' instead until `until`, or until the line is removed. Applied by tools/lib/pt-holds.mjs (tagPtHold at every sector bake/save).

bs1e-4.why: KB P78 / ledger O-14: the Nov 16 90-day median ($4,500) rests on PriceCharting rows whose titles never say 1st Edition (6 of 10; $500–$4,500); the 4 clean 1st Edition rows median ~$10,100. No sale after Nov 12, so the 'down 36%' move is not a market move. Verifier confirmed Nov 18. Root cause: 1st Edition title check in tools/build-sector-index.mjs (from the Nov 19 mark).

bs1e-2.why: Price Truth Nov 20: the Nov 19 90-day median ($1,250, 15 rows) prints 'Biggest move ▲39%' against the $900 Nov 16 mark; PriceCharting 1st Ed ungraded $878.51 (Nov 20), clean 1st Ed raw sales since Oct 26 median ~$868 ($456-$1,373). Verifier confirmed Nov 20. Not a market move; held until the 1st Ed rows settle.

nd1e-108.why: Price Truth Nov 20: after the 1st Edition title check the Nov 19 mark rests on 2 September sales ($391, $340) and prints 'Biggest move ▼53%' ($770.32 -> $365.50) and a 1st Ed mark below Unlimited ($371, n30). PriceCharting 1st Ed ungraded $524.74; 2026 1st Ed raw sales ~$400-$1,200. Verifier confirmed Nov 20.

bs1e-10.why: Price Truth Nov 24: the Nov 23 90-day median ($400, 11 rows, from $650) includes a German ($232.89, Nov 8) and a French ($225, Nov 1) copy; without them the median is ~$750, near PriceCharting's ~$821 1st Ed ungraded. Verifier confirmed Nov 24. Root cause: European-language words added to TITLE_BAD in tools/build-sector-index.mjs (from the Nov 26 mark).

tu19-170.why: Price Truth Nov 25: the Nov 23 30-day median ($1,497.50, 14 rows, from $2,200) printed a home mover '$2,200 -> $1,498'. PriceCharting ungraded $2,316.47; cheapest TCGplayer listing $2,399.99; the window carries an Indonesian copy ($1,195, Nov 6), an HP copy ($1,330.33) and $490/$800 outliers. Verifier confirmed Nov 25. Root cause (part): Indonesian/Thai words added to TITLE_BAD in tools/build-sector-index.mjs (from the Nov 26 mark); condition words are a CoS question.
